def fails(parser, action):
    try:
        action()
    except app.StreamError:
        assert parser.state == \"FAILED\"
        assert parser.buffered_bytes == 0
    else:
        raise AssertionError(\"expected StreamError\")

# UTF-8 character split at every byte boundary, plus incomplete-frame accounting.
p = app.EventStream()
wire = \"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"你🧪\\\"}\\n{\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\"}\\n\".encode()
out = []
for byte in wire:
    out.extend(p.feed(bytes([byte])))
assert out == [{\"event\": \"token\", \"text\": \"你🧪\"}, {\"event\": \"done\", \"text\": \"你🧪\", \"characters\": 2, \"words\": 1}]
assert p.state == \"DONE\" and p.buffered_bytes == 0 and p.finish() == p.finish() == []

# Small per-frame cap allows large chunks containing many small complete frames.
frame = b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"\\\"}\\n\"
p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=len(frame) - 1)
assert len(p.feed(frame * 50 + b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\"}\\n\")) == 51

# Exact limit accepted; one byte over rejected, including on completed frame.
p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=4)
assert p.feed(b\"{}\\n\") == []
fails(p, lambda: p.feed(b\"12345\"))
p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=2)
fails(p, lambda: p.feed(b\"{}x\\n\"))

# Any byte after a terminal frame in the same or a later feed fails.
for suffix in (b\"x\", b\"\\n\"):
    p = app.EventStream()
    fails(p, lambda: p.feed(b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\"}\\n\" + suffix))
p = app.EventStream()
p.feed(b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"error\\\",\\\"message\\\":\\\"no\\\"}\\n\")
assert p.state == \"ERROR\" and p.finish() == []
fails(p, lambda: p.feed(b\"z\"))

# Malformed frame and duplicate keys fail terminally; premature EOF clears bytes.
p = app.EventStream()
fails(p, lambda: p.feed(b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"y\\\"}\\n\"))
p = app.EventStream()
p.feed(b\"{\\\"event\\\":\")
assert p.buffered_bytes == len(b\"{\\\"event\\\":\")
fails(p, p.finish)
fails(p, lambda: p.feed(b\"\"))
print(\"contract checks passed\")'"
